blocks.x: AIOps & Autonomous IT Operations exists because a specific failure keeps repeating: alerts flood; correlation is human; incident duration depends on who's on call; changes cause outages nobody predicted.
Alerts flood; correlation is human; incident duration depends on who's on call; changes cause outages nobody predicted.

The pattern behind AIOps & Autonomous IT Operations: decisions that should be systematized are still assembled by hand — one document, one queue, one meeting at a time. This solution replaces the assembly with a governed composition.

We build the AIOps backbone: event correlation across estate, SLO-based alerting on symptoms, agentic remediation for known classes, change-risk models feeding release policy, and chaos drills that prove recovery.

blocks.x: AIOps & Autonomous IT Operations composes Dataq Swarm, Dataq Forge — platforms with documented controls and evidence packs, so governance is part of the runtime. The pattern is in delivery now in Technology & SaaS, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Banking & Financial Services, Retail & Consumer Goods.

AIOps & Autonomous IT Operations runs on phases: phase one prices the problem in your own units and signs the baseline; phase two designs with the risk envelope written down; phase three proves a bounded slice on your data; phase four scales what survived the gate. What we promise is modest and checkable: a signed baseline, a bounded slice in production, and evidence your auditors can read without a guide. For AIOps & Autonomous IT Operations, that discipline is not optional — it is the engagement model.
